import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler


def calculate_logloss(y_true, y_pred):
    """Calculate multi-class logarithmic loss"""
    N = len(y_true)
    y_true_arr = np.array(y_true)
    probs = y_pred.copy()

    # Rescale probabilities to sum to 1 per row
    for i in range(N):
        row_sum = probs[i].sum()
        if row_sum > 0:
            probs[i] = probs[i] / row_sum

    # Clip extreme values
    eps = 1e-15
    probs = np.clip(probs, eps, 1 - eps)

    total_loss = 0.0
    for i in range(N):
        true_class_idx = int(np.argmax(y_true_arr[i]))
        total_loss += -np.log(probs[i][true_class_idx])

    return total_loss / N


def main():
    print("Loading data...")
    train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

    print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
    print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

    # Extract features with standardization in mind
    def extract_features_and_normalize(df, scaler=None):
        feature_cols = ["margin_", "shape_", "texture_"]
        all_cols = df.columns.tolist()
        cols = [
            c
            for c in all_cols
            if any(kw in c for kw in ["margin", "shape", "texture"])
            and not c.endswith("id")
        ]
        df_normalized = df[cols].copy()

        # Apply z-score normalization if needed
        if scaler is None:
            scaler = StandardScaler()
            df_normalized = pd.DataFrame(
                scaler.fit_transform(df_normalized),
                columns=[f"{col}_norm_{i}" for i, col in enumerate(cols)],
            )
        else:
            df_normalized = pd.DataFrame(
                scaler.transform(df_normalized[cols]), columns=cols
            )

        return df_normalized.values, scaler

    # Normalize all datasets with same scaling
    X_train_raw, scalers = extract_features_and_normalize(train_df)
    X_val, _ = extract_features_and_normalize(None)
    X_test, _ = extract_features_and_normalize(None)

    # Get unique classes
    y_train_raw = train_df["species"].astype(str)
    unique_classes = sorted(list(set(y_train_raw)))
    class_to_code = {cls: idx for idx, cls in enumerate(unique_classes)}

    n_classes = len(unique_classes)
    y_train_codes = [class_to_code[y_train_raw[i]] for i in range(len(y_train_raw))]

    print(f"Training samples: {len(X_train_raw)}, Validation samples after split")

    # Stratified split
    X_train_split, X_val, y_train_split, y_val_codes = train_test_split(
        X_train_raw,
        y_train_codes,
        test_size=0.2,
        random_state=42,
        stratify=y_train_codes,
    )

    # Train base model first for stability
    base_clf = RandomForestClassifier(
        n_estimators=500, max_depth=20, min_samples_leaf=5, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1
    )

    # Fit and then calibrate
    clf_base = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_clf, method="isotonic", cv="prefit")
    clf_base.fit(X_train_split, y_train_split)

    # Validate on held-out set
    y_val_pred_prob = clf_base.predict_proba(X_val)
    logloss_val = calculate_logloss(y_val_codes, y_val_pred_prob)
    print(f"Validation LogLoss (held-out): {logloss_val:.6f}")

    # Final predictions on test set
    y_test_pred_prob = clf_base.predict_proba(X_test)

    # Ensure proper probability distribution for submission
    final_probs = y_test_pred_prob.copy()
    for i in range(len(final_probs)):
        row_sum = final_probs[i].sum()
        if row_sum > 1e-10:
            final_probs[i] = final_probs[i] / row_sum
        final_probs[i] = np.clip(final_probs[i], 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

    # Create submission
    sample_cols = [col.strip() for col in sample_sub.columns]
    output_rows = []
    for i, pid in enumerate(sample_sub["id"]):
        pred_row = [pid] + list(final_probs[i])
        output_rows.append(pred_row)

    sub_df = pd.DataFrame(output_rows, columns=sample_cols)
    sub_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Saved predictions to ./submission/submission.csv")
    print(f"Final Validation LogLoss (held-out): {logloss_val:.6f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
